Complete [[Assault on the Stronghold]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Assault the Stronghold and free the [[Ebon Vanguard]] captives from [[Hierophant Burntsoul]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Assault on the Stronghold]] quest.
